description.fallback: Empowered by Joseph's blood, DIO relishes in his newfound power, laughing maniacally as he repeatedly claws out his head. He then taunts Jotaro for inadvertently helping him recover his powers. As DIO continues to laugh, Joseph's spirit manifests in front of Jotaro, warning him not to get angry and use his powers wisely during his battle with DIO.
